description: Who reacted to a message with a given emoji.

emoji.description: The reaction to list. A standard emoji (the character itself), or one of this server's custom emoji by name, like party or :party:, or as <:party:ID>.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

message_id.description: Message ID, or the message's link.
